name: Thurn
kurzbeschreibung: Charming village above Lienz, offering stunning views of the town and the surrounding mountains.
beschreibung:
Thurn lies on a sunny high plateau about 250 meters above the valley floor of Lienz. At 819 meters above sea level, the village with its roughly 600 inhabitants perches above the district capital of Osttirol and offers a sweeping view down into the Drautal as well as of the Lienzer Dolomiten. Anyone standing up here can, when the air is clear, see all the way across to the Schobergruppe and the Großglockner.

The village belongs to the municipality of Thurn, which consists of several small hamlets. Characteristic are the traditional Osttiroler farms with their low-slung gable roofs, clustered around the parish church. The paths between the farms are short, the neighbors know one another – that makes Thurn a place where families with children find peace without having to forgo the infrastructure of Lienz. The town with schools, doctors, and shopping facilities can be reached by car in just a few minutes.

You can hike here directly from the house: marked trails lead over meadows and through open larch forests up toward Zettersfeld and over the slopes of the Rauchkofels. In winter, the slopes above the village are often the first to lie in the sun, while fog still hangs down in the valley. Thurn is not a place for big tourist staging, but for those seeking the quiet, authentic Osttirol – with Lienz literally at your feet.
